requirement.statement: The LLM wiki visualization frontend SHALL provide a local repo knowledge workbench for status, indexing, semantic search, graph visualization, wiki build, named query, and tool debugging workflows.

case.when: A user opens the visualization frontend
case.then: The frontend SHALL show server status and allow semantic search results to be visualized as graph nodes

case.given: Graph data contains long CodeKnowledge ids, file paths, or embedding ids
case.when: The frontend renders the graph canvas
case.then: The canvas SHALL show compact semantic node labels, keep full ids and snippets in hover or selection details, and hide edge labels by default

case.given: A graph node maps to a code or document block with text content
case.when: A user selects the node and opens its block popup
case.then: The frontend SHALL show a large modal with the block content, full id, and available metadata

case.given: Semantic search returns embedding item ids and source ids
case.when: The frontend projects the result into graph data
case.then: The graph SHALL use a search/query root connected to source result nodes and SHALL NOT show embedding ids as visible graph nodes

case.when: A user uses Wiki, Named Query, or Tools tabs
case.then: The frontend SHALL call the corresponding server API and render structured JSON results
